label: FP
reason: The header name retrieved from getHeaders is used as the parameter value, but in the switch statement within doSomething, the switchTarget is determined by guess.charAt(1) which is 'B'. This causes the code to always assign 'bob' to bar, regardless of the header name, so the user-provided header name never reaches the XSS sink.

evidence.note: Header name used as param, but switchTarget 'B' always assigns constant 'bob' to bar
